basic_info.description: Mid-Century Home in the Heart of the Inner Sunset!  Welcome to this timeless three-level residence, ideally situated in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Just 1.5 blocks from the N-Judah MUNI line for a quick commute downtown, and a short stroll to the vibrant 9th & Irving corridor, UCSF, Golden Gate Park, and an array of beloved shops, cafes, and restaurants on Irving Street this location truly has it all.  Lovingly held by the same family for decades, this classic mid-century home offers a spacious and practical layout. The top floor features three generous bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The primary bedroom has an ensuite bathroom with a pleasant outlook over the treetops of Golden Gate Park.  On the main level, you'll find an inviting open living room with a corner fireplace, formal dining area, convenient half bath, and a bright kitchen with direct access to the rear yard ideal for entertaining, grilling, and indoor/outdoor activities. The lower level boasts a large, spacious two-car side-by-side garage with two independent doors, ample storage, and a convenient laundry area. This central location is ideal for those wanting to be close to conveniences with great walkability to transportation, shops, dining, schools, and Golden Gate Park activities.
